name: Los Angeles Zoo Teen Council for Conservation
reason: The program page is a 404. The only page found is an Apr 22, 2024 blog post with no ages, dates or application. The current volunteer page lists only Core, Docent and Keeper volunteers.

name: Merced County Library volunteers
reason: The official page only links to an application form and Friends of the Library. It lists no roles or ages for teens on the page itself.

name: Rady Children's Hospital teen volunteers
reason: The hospital volunteer page states a one-year, 100-hour commitment and says applications are closed until Monday, Aug 24, but no page gives a minimum age or says teens can apply.

name: Qualcomm Thinkabit Lab
reason: Taught through partner schools and districts (such as Morse High School and Sweetwater Union High School District). There is no open application for individual students.

name: San Diego State University pre-college
reason: The only official SDSU summer page found is for admitted first-year college students. No current high school pre-college program page was found.

name: City of Pomona youth jobs and Pomona Public Library teen volunteers
reason: No official youth employment or library teen volunteer page was found on pomonaca.gov. The only open city volunteer posting (youth music program) got its own card.

name: Merced Union High School District work permit page
reason: The issue already said this page was not found. Work permits are covered by the guide's permit pages, not a program card.

name: City of Goleta internship program
reason: Only a 2019 policy document mentions internships. No current internship posting for high school students was found.
